title: Analyzing the Targets of Hate in Online Social Media
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and characterizing the targets of hate speech on Whisper and Twitter. While 'Religion' is included as one of the nine categories used to classify hate targets (Table 3 and Table 4), the study aims to measure the prevalence of hateful content rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious doctrines, faith traditions, theology, or ethical frameworks themselves.
